message.text: The derived metadata appears to be MemoPayload fields such as tags, HasLink, HasCode, and title extracted from H1 headings during markdown processing.

I will examine the UpdateMemo section to find content update triggers and ExtractAll in markdown.go to list extracted properties.

The MemoPayload proto will also be checked to see what metadata is stored.

Derived metadata lives in `memo.Payload` (MemoPayload). It covers Tags and Property fields computed from content.

`memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` orchestrates the work. `(*service).ExtractAll` in `internal/markdown/markdown.go` performs the actual extraction. `RebuildMemoPayload` persists Tags and Property. Mentions are extracted but not stored in Payload. Recomputation triggers on `CreateMemo` and on `UpdateMemo` when the update mask includes "content".

`memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` can batch-rebuild all memos, yet it is not wired into production server startup.

Location is user-set. Tags and Property are derived from content.

The computation extracts #tags, has_link, has_task_list, has_code, has_incomplete_tasks, and title from the first H1.

Mentions are extracted in `ExtractAll` but not written to Payload. They are consumed separately by `memo_mention_helpers` for notifications.

Production triggers are CreateMemo and UpdateMemo on the content path.

A RunOnce mechanism exists in the runner, but the runner is not started in the server.

h14.
**computation site:** `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`) → `markdown.Service.ExtractAll` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go`); **triggers:** `CreateMemo`, `UpdateMemo` when `content` is in the update mask (and optionally `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce`, which is not wired into server startup); **extracted properties:** `#tags` → `payload.tags`; links/code/task lists/H1 title → `payload.property` (`has_link`, `has_code`, `has_task_list`, `has_incomplete_tasks`, `title`)

Each memo’s derived metadata lives in `MemoPayload` (`proto/store/memo.proto`), mainly `tags` and `property` parsed from markdown content.

### Computation site

Orchestration is in `RebuildMemoPayload`, which calls `ExtractAll` and writes into the memo payload:

```74:87:server/runner/memopayload/runner.go
func RebuildMemoPayload(_ context.Context, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service) error {
	if memo.Payload == nil {
		memo.Payload = &storepb.MemoPayload{}
	}
	data, err := markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))
	// ...
	memo.Payload.Tags = data.Tags
	memo.Payload.Property = data.Property
	return nil
}
```

Parsing happens in `ExtractAll` on the goldmark AST:

```355:421:internal/markdown/markdown.go
func (s *service) ExtractAll(content []byte) (*ExtractedData, error) {
	// ...
	// tags from #tag nodes, mentions from @mention nodes
	// property: title from first H1, has_link, has_code, has_task_list, has_incomplete_tasks
```

Only `Tags` and `Property` are persisted by `RebuildMemoPayload`. `@mentions` are extracted in `ExtractAll` but used separately (e.g. `server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go`), not stored in `payload`.

User-provided fields like `location` are set separately after rebuild on create (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:111-112`).

### Triggers (recomputation)

| Operation | Path | When |
|---|---|---|
| **CreateMemo** | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` | Before `Store.CreateMemo`, always |
| **UpdateMemo** | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:436-451` | Only when update mask includes `"content"` |
| **Runner.RunOnce** | `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:52` | Batch-rebuilds all memos; `memopayload.Runner` is **not** started from `server/server.go`, so this does not run in normal server operation |

### Extracted properties

From `proto/store/memo.proto` and `ExtractAll`:

| Stored field | Extracted from content |
|---|---|
| `payload.tags` | `#tag` tokens (deduplicated, case preserved) |
| `payload.property.has_link` | Any link node |
| `payload.property.has_code` | Code block, fenced code block, or inline code |
| `payload.property.has_task_list` | GFM task checkbox |
| `payload.property.has_incomplete_tasks` | Unchecked task checkbox |
| `payload.property.title` | Text of the first top-level H1 heading |

These support list filtering (tags/properties in the filter engine) and previews (e.g. title, snippet generation uses separate `GenerateSnippet` in webhooks, not payload rebuild).
